         (RR : A -> B -> Prop),
       (forall (i : I1) (j : I2),
        SI i j ->
        @PEutt.peutt E MN MF FI FC MX FO (I1 + A) (I2 + B)
          (@PStruct.pstruct_iter_sum_rel I1 I2 A B SI RR) (step1 i) (step2 j)) ->
       forall (c : @HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I1 A) E MN A)
         (d : @HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I2 B) E MN B),
       @Iteration.iteration_configs E MN MF FI FC MX FO I1 I2 A B SI RR c d ->
       @Measure.sem_lift MF FI

            (@HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I1 A) E MN A)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN A))
         (PrimitiveStableHitting.stable_target
            (@HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I2 B) E MN B)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN B))
         (@RelationalHitting.stable_target_rel
            (@HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I1 A) E MN A)
            (@HandlerMachine.handler_config (Iteration.iterationE I2 B) E MN B)
            (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN A) (UnifiedFrontier.stable_head E MN B)

            (@PEutt.ptree_stable_head_rel E MN A B RR

         (@HandlerMachine.handler_machine_kernel MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select
            (Iteration.iterationE I1 A) E (@Iteration.iteration_handler I1 A E MN step1) A c)
         (@HandlerMachine.handler_machine_kernel MN MF FI MX FO Ord Select
